text: We are pleased to announce our participation in the 20th edition of Contemporary Istanbul, with a presentation of paintings by Nicholas Campbell, Francesco Cima, Bill Jensen, Leonardo Meoni, Daniele Milvio, Marco Scarpi, Adrian Schachter and Alessandro Twombly.
